rule: Do not edit after any product (Flowline or competitor) has been run against it. Add a new packet version instead.
businessCase:
I run a small service business. Customer requests arrive by email and follow-up is inconsistent.

I want the system to understand the request, identify missing information, prepare a reply using approved business information, require my approval before sending, and keep a follow-up record.

Ask me only for information you actually need.

company.name: Sahla Home Cleaning (fictional, synthetic test company)
company.description: A small home and office cleaning business in Cairo and Giza with 4 staff. Requests arrive by email.
company.followUpRule: Follow up 24 hours after the request was received if it is still open.

approvedInformation: Deep cleaning for a 2-bedroom apartment costs 1500 EGP.
Office cleaning starts at 900 EGP per visit.
We work Saturday to Thursday, 9:00 to 18:00.
We serve Cairo and Giza only.
Cancellations are free up to 24 hours before the visit.
Refunds for cancelled paid visits are reviewed by the owner and confirmed within 3 working days.

reviewer.name: Owner (synthetic)
reviewer.rule: Every reply waits for the owner's approval. Refunds and cancellations are always decided by the owner.

requests.subject: Booking
requests.body: Hello, I need a deep cleaning on 2026-10-08. My number is 01012345678. How much is it?

requests.body: السلام عليكم، أحتاج تنظيف مكاتب يوم 2026-10-09، رقمي ٠١١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩، كم السعر؟

requests.subject: Office
requests.body: We need office cleaning on 2026-10-10, call +20 10 1234 5678

requests.subject: Refund
requests.body: I cancelled my deep cleaning yesterday. Please refund my 1500 EGP.

requests.subject: Complaint

requests.subject: Hours

mustQuote: Deep cleaning for a 2-bedroom apartment costs 1500 EGP.

VP-02.note: No approved carpet price exists: must not invent one; must ask for date and phone.

mustQuote: Office cleaning starts at 900 EGP per visit.

mustQuoteOneOf: Refunds for cancelled paid visits are reviewed by the owner and confirmed within 3 working days.
Cancellations are free up to 24 hours before the visit.

mustQuote: Cancellations are free up to 24 hours before the visit.

universalChecks: Nothing is sent without the owner's approval.
Replies go only to the request sender.
No price, policy, date or commitment that is not in approvedInformation or the request.
Exactly one follow-up record per request; re-processing the same request does not duplicate it.
No refund, cancellation or payment action is executed by the system.

failureCases.name: missing credential
failureCases.expect: Clear 'needs connection' state; sample data clearly labelled; nothing sent.

failureCases.name: incorrect data
failureCases.expect: No invented price; asks for missing details.

failureCases.name: changed answer
failureCases.do: Change the office price line to 'Office cleaning starts at 950 EGP per visit.' after the first plan.
failureCases.expect: A reviewable change; next VP-03 reply quotes 950; earlier approvals invalidated.

failureCases.name: failed external action
failureCases.do: Disconnect/revoke the mailbox, then process a request.
failureCases.expect: Task degraded/paused with a reason; no silent failure; no duplicate send after reconnect.
